import numpy as np

def compute_meteor(generated, reference):
    gen_tokens = generated.lower().split()
    ref_tokens = reference.lower().split()
    matches = sum(1 for t in gen_tokens if t in ref_tokens)
    precision = matches / max(len(gen_tokens), 1)
    recall = matches / max(len(ref_tokens), 1)
    f_mean = (10 * precision * recall) / (recall + 9 * precision + 1e-10)
    chunks = 1  # simplified: assume single chunk
    penalty = 0.5 * (chunks / max(matches, 1)) ** 3
    meteor = f_mean * (1 - penalty)
    return meteor
